from.slates: OddsPapi (65 games pulled, median of books)

how.A: CFB rebuild v4 (desk v3 unblended + program SRS + coach career win% + crowd size; total + in-season tempo) + player usage prior + missing starters; drive-simulator ranges, key-number margin curve (sd 16.2)
how.B: Sharp-weighted devigged market; look-ahead lines (kickoff 4+ days out) trust 44% of a spread gap, later lines 34%. Spread A = look-ahead gap 4+, B = look-ahead 3-4 or later gap 4+; totals: look-ahead unders 4+ lean, the rest pass; moneyline lean at most.

reasons: Kickoff in 0.1 days: game-week line: gaps of 4+ at the close still covered 55% (1,005 bets, 2022-25), so a lean at most
The desk model (v3) is on the same side of the line
Week 8+: Model A's in-season ratings carry the most weight by now

u.why: Gap under 2: smaller than the tested sizes (CFB game-week spread gaps 2+ covered 53.4% (2,062, 2022-25))

reasons: Total gaps below 4 or on game-week lines have not held up (2022-25 closes 51%)
Tempo: Model A's total uses both teams' plays per game this season, shrunk toward each head coach's pace

u.why: CFB game-week totals have not held up (2022-25 closes 51%)

reasons: Moneyline prices the spread's trusted edge as a win chance (key-number margin curve); untested on prices, a lean at most, only near pick'em. Win chance = the books' no-vig moneyline moved only by that trusted edge

u.why: Moneyline chance converted from the spread with a normal curve, never tested in any sport; that conversion makes big underdogs look +EV on its own, so ML ratings are capped at 60 and never a small play
